outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of the experimental pipeline, not a data plot.
Panel B shows representative fluorescence, H&E, and bright-field micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C is a bar chart of mean lactate concentration with individual data points (dots) overlaid for each group (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC).
Panel D is a bar chart of mean lactate concentration with individual data points (dots) overlaid for the high pH and low pH groups.
Panel E is a schematic illustration of the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment model, not a data plot.
